CustomField.description: SMS Text Number(s) / mobile number(s) that should be notified on L5 escalations (comma separated)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The SMS Text Numbers / mobile phone number(s) ) use for Case Escalations. For example, when a L5 Escalation for this team is raised these phone numbers will receive a text to this group. To specify a single phone number simply type in the phone number, 15551234567 or specify multiple email numbers comma separated values 15551234567, 15557654321.
